title: Stale Authorization State in Permission Cache
description: Permission revocation updates primary database but omits cache eviction, preserving unauthorized access.
security_invariant: Revocation of authorization must immediately reflect in subsequent permission queries.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: After revoke_authorization('user-1'), is_authorized('user-1') continues returning True.
required_secure_behavior: After revoke_authorization('user-1'), is_authorized('user-1') immediately returns False.
